decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design and Access Statement, Flood Risk Assessment, 0200(00)00, 0200(00)01, 0200(00)02, 0200(00)03, 0200(00)04, 0200(00)05, 0200(01)01, 0200(01)02, 0200(01)03, 0200(01)04, and 0200(01)05 received: 05/10/2017) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Erection of a side roof extension at third floor level to the main building and side roof extension to the roof of the two storey rear projection
